mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDeviceCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'LTE-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lteCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'VHF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vhfCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(AutoSwitchingRadio) = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoSwitchCnt, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED)), 1) AS avgRsrp, ROUND(AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED)), 1) AS avgRsrq, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 OR CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cautionDeviceCnt, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(RCV_DT), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRcvDt FROM tbl_last_data

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.RCV_DT, '%H:%i') AS label, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(A.CurrentRadioType)) = 'LTE-R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lteCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(A.CurrentRadioType)) = 'VHF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vhfCnt FROM tbl_receive_data A WHERE A.RCV_DT >= ( SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(RCV_DT), INTERVAL 11 MINUTE) FROM tbl_receive_data ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(A.RCV_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), DATE_FORMAT(A.RCV_DT, '%H:%i') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(A.RCV_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'LTE-R' THEN 'LTE-R' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'VHF' THEN 'VHF' ELSE '기타' END AS radioType, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_last_data), 0), 0) AS ratio FROM tbl_last_data GROUP BY CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'LTE-R' THEN 'LTE-R' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(CurrentRadioType)) = 'VHF' THEN 'VHF' ELSE '기타' END ORDER BY CASE radioType WHEN 'LTE-R' THEN 1 WHEN 'VHF' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT S.sortOrder AS sortOrder, S.status AS status, S.statusClass AS statusClass, S.rangeText AS rangeText, COALESCE(A.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT 1 AS sortOrder, '정상' AS status, 'normal' AS statusClass, 'RSRP >= -90' AS rangeText UNION ALL SELECT 2, '주의', 'caution', '-100 <= RSRP < -90' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '경고', 'warning', '-110 <= RSRP < -100' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '심각', 'critical', 'RSRP < -110' ) S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -110 THEN 4 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -100 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tbl_last_data GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -110 THEN 4 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -100 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ) A ON S.sortOrder = A.sortOrder ORDER BY S.sortOrder ASC

SELECT S.sortOrder AS sortOrder, S.status AS status, S.statusClass AS statusClass, S.rangeText AS rangeText, COALESCE(A.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT 1 AS sortOrder, '정상' AS status, 'normal' AS statusClass, 'RSRQ >= -10' AS rangeText UNION ALL SELECT 2, '주의', 'caution', '-15 <= RSRQ < -10' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '경고', 'warning', '-18 <= RSRQ < -15' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '심각', 'critical', 'RSRQ < -18' ) S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -18 THEN 4 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -15 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS sortOrder, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tbl_last_data GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -18 THEN 4 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -15 THEN 3 WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END ) A ON S.sortOrder = A.sortOrder ORDER BY S.sortOrder ASC

SELECT A.VoLTE_NUM AS volteNum, A.CAR_NUM AS carNum, A.CurrentRadioType AS currentRadioType, A.RSRP AS rsrp, CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -110 THEN '심각' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -100 THEN '경고' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 THEN '주의' ELSE '정상' END AS rsrpStatus, CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -110 THEN 'critical' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -100 THEN 'warning' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRP), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -90 THEN 'caution' ELSE 'normal' END AS rsrpStatusClass, A.RSRQ AS rsrq, CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -18 THEN '심각' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -15 THEN '경고' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN '주의' ELSE '정상' END AS rsrqStatus, CASE WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -18 THEN 'critical' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -15 THEN 'warning' WHEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(A.RSRQ), 'DBM', ''), 'DB', '')), '') AS SIGNED) < -10 THEN 'caution' ELSE 'normal' END AS rsrqStatusClass, DATE_FORMAT(A.RCV_DT, '%H:%i:%s') AS rcvTime FROM tbl_receive_data A ORDER BY A.RCV_DT DESC LIMIT 7
